## Terminal handoff — T165P135 contribution review r1

**Verdict.** SUBSTANTIAL (conditional on correctness) for the full frozen claim: for all positive m, n, every even-adjacent drawing of $K_{m,n}$ has at least $d_m d_n$ oddly crossing edge pairs, with exactness and the corollaries ocr± = ocr+ = pcr+ = $d_m d_n$ = cr($K_{m,n}$) (last via pinned thm:main).

**Why.** No located statement or composition yields the theorem. Both pinned preprints contain no parity content; Pach–Tóth 2000, Szekely 2004/2008, FPSS 2012, BFK 2015, and the DS21 survey contain no exact odd/pair crossing value for $K_{m,n}$ in any class; the classical GF(2) theory is documented (DS21 on Levow) as not precise enough to decide values. The pinned mechanism's two engines fail verbatim in characteristic 2 (two-sided averaging divides by 2; the detector input is signed with division), so the author's replacements — one-sided shift with exact diagonal bookkeeping (Lemma 3), 0/1 order-matrix detector input (Lemma 8), and the even-adjacent = diagonal-block-invertibility identification (Section 8) — are constructed steps, not citations. This separates it from the TECHNICAL precedents (t184i134: operative step was literally Kang's Lemma 2.2; t106o133: archived routine transfer) and aligns with the SUBSTANTIAL ones (t088p133, t205m, t117q).

**Conditioning and limits.** Correctness not assessed; parent attention items stand (Lemma 2 apparent `t(u1,·)=0` typo cancelling mod 2; Lemma 1 round-disk/no-reentry normalization). Freeze-timing disclosure preserved as author-recorded (freeze 2026-10-20T18:22:29Z, substantial char-2 feasibility prefreeze); no independent timing certification. Tutte 1970 and Levow 1972 bodies unobtainable (recorded failures; relied on Pach–Tóth Lemma 4.1, Szekely 2008 §3, DS21). Szekely 2008 was obtained (amc-journal.eu) and read in full: his optimality criterion names Zarankiewicz's drawing as a "natural candidate" without verifying it, computing no values.
